cands.name: Eric Ager
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 114 (Buncombe County) since 2023. Retired U.S. Navy commander, naval aviator and Foreign Area Officer. Former professor of national security studies at the Marshall Center. Works as operations manager at Hickory Nut Gap Farm and runs the nonprofit Project HNG.

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina is listed among his 2026 endorsements and voter guide recommendations, alongside several volunteer "Sway" voting groups.

cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace. We found no documented statements or actions by him on data centers, property taxes, development and land protection, immigration and H-1B, policing, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026, and his campaign site describes his values in general terms without policy positions. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties.

local.label: Roots 90: His campaign site says he grew up on a working family farm in Fairview and played soccer for A.C. Reynolds High School, and that he returned to Buncombe County after his Navy career; his birthplace is not stated.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has served in the NC House since January 2023. Spent 25 years in the Navy as a pilot and Foreign Area Officer, retiring as a Commander. Taught national security studies at the George C. Marshall Center. Now works as operations manager and director of business operations at Hickory Nut Gap Farm, runs a small business, and leads the nonprofit Project HNG.
qual.why: Scored in the high range for holding legislative office since 2023, plus a career with policy-related and management work. Committee assignments were not counted.
